With 10 S19j Pros you already know the pool side cold. What a small unit adds is the solo shot — it draws for the full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, and it's quiet enough to sit indoors.

The H15 Dual hasn't opened for sale yet, no drop date announced. The one you can buy today is the Harlo B30, $899, ~30 TH/s, ships November 30.
